terbaru.judul: Enhancing the Security of Rollup Sequencers using Decentrally Attested TEEs
terbaru.pelajaran: In this paper, we propose a TEE-secured Sequencer equipped with a decentralized attestation mechanism.

terbaru.judul: MAD-DAG: Protecting Blockchain Consensus from MEV
terbaru.pelajaran: We present MAD-DAG, Mutually-Assured-Destruction Directed-Acyclic-Graph, the first practical protocol to counter selfish mining under adverse conditions.

terbaru.judul: On Addressing Isolation in Blockchain-Based Self-Sovereign Identity
terbaru.pelajaran: Self-Sovereign Identity (SSI) grants holders full ownership and control of their digital identities, being the ultimate digital identity model.

terbaru.judul: A Patient-Centric Blockchain Framework for Secure Electronic Health Record Management: Decoupling Data Storage from Access Control
terbaru.pelajaran: We present a patient-centric architecture for electronic health record (EHR) sharing that separates content storage from authorization and audit.

terbaru.judul: Auditable Ledger Snapshot for Non-Repudiable Cross-Blockchain Communication
terbaru.pelajaran: In response, this paper introduces InterSnap, a novel blockchain snapshot archival methodology, for enabling auditability of crossblockchain transactions, enforcing non-repudiation.

terbaru.judul: A Quantum-Secure and Blockchain-Integrated E-Voting Framework with Identity Validation
terbaru.pelajaran: We introduce a post-quantum-secure evoting architecture that integrates Falcon lattice-based digital signatures, biometric authentication via MobileNetV3 and AdaFace, and a permissioned blockchain for tamper-proof vote storage.

terbaru.judul: Know Your Intent: An Autonomous Multi-Perspective LLM Agent Framework for DeFi User Transaction Intent Mining
terbaru.pelajaran: To address this, we propose the Transaction Intent Mining (TIM) framework.

terbaru.judul: The Walls Have Ears: Unveiling Cross-Chain Sandwich Attacks in DeFi
terbaru.pelajaran: In this work, we investigate cross-chain sandwich attacks targeting liquidity pool-based cross-chain bridge protocols.
